text:
Power Stations
Technical Procedure
M2530
Introduction
This 
document out lines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed every 
six months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
Cooling Water Heat Exchanger 
used for cooling water circuit to cool the auxiliary equipment.
Technical Specifications:
The first draft initiated by eng. , tested by 
eng. Hussien Kamal Shaliby and revised by EDEPC quality control engineer 
Abouda Elbana, accepted by general director eng. Yosry Abd Elmaqsood, and 
approved by eng. Awad Fathay head sector of Talkha power station.
This document updated by 
eng. Mahmoud Abou Elfetouh Shata, accepted by general manager eng.
Mamdoh Anber, approved by eng. Farouk Awad Aly, 
revised by eng. Abouda El-Bana, 
certified by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel 
MDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS coordinator and 
approved by eng. Mohamed Nageb : MDEPC inspection & quality control head sector
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance stuff should be carry the 
suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmet and shoes.
Isolate the cooling water heat 
 exchanger by closing the inlet and out let valve.
Drain the heat exchanger.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance 
 tool set.
Air Compressor.
Rags.
Work to be Carried Out
Unbolt water boxes 
 bolts.
Dismantle the water 
 boxes.
Remove the used (old) 
 gasket and replace with a new gasket if necessary.
Clean all tubes compressed air and water.
Clean water boxes by 
 brush and water.
Inspect tube leakage 
 by pressurizing the heat exchanger and blocking any pipe leaks.
Inspect water boxes 
 coating and repair if needed.
Reassemble the water 
 boxes.
